items.title: Palli Sanchay Bank deposits Tk 60 crore dividend in govt treasury
items.description: Palli Sanchay Bank has deposited Tk 60 crore in dividends declared in favour of the government for the period up to the 2023-24 fiscal year into the government treasury.

items.title: Bangladesh Bank restores website after two-and-a-half-day shutdown over cyber alert
items.description: Bangladesh Bank has restored its website at 8am today after keeping it offline for two-and-a-half days as a precaution against potential cyber threats following a global cybersecurity alert.

items.title: Indonesia cuts gas exports to Singapore
items.description: Indonesia cut exports of natural gas to Singapore on Saturday to prioritise domestic demand, an official said, with the two countries at loggerheads over regional air pollution emanating from wildfires on the vast archipelago.

items.title: Trump lifts some Canada tariffs ahead of midterms
items.description: President Donald Trump’s administration lifted some tariffs on Canadian imports Friday, two weeks ahead of midterm elections, after a vulnerable Republican candidate said she’d lobbied for the change.
